name: ClipSD: hotkeys
description: ClipSD hotkeys (area screenshot, full-screen screenshot) on every keyboard layout at once, e.g. Alt+W also works with a Cyrillic layout. Change the hotkeys in ClipSD settings. The "Record video" button opens the built-in GNOME screen recorder. (C) 2026 Sergey Dayneko, GPL-3.0-or-later
